title: delphinium delavayi var. baoshanense

This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
